C0188.title: Yanggu Police Dismantle Online Water Army Hubs Using Group-Control Devices to Inflate Livestream Viewer Numbers
C0188.summary: China Peace reported that the cyber police brigade of Yanggu County Public Security Bureau in Shandong, together with Qiaorun Police Station, cracked an illegal business case, arrested two suspects, and seized more than 100 phones, 120 phone motherboards, and six group-control devices. The suspects used group-control devices to operate 120 phones simultaneously and provided paid livestream popularity-inflation services.
